title: India's TCS rises on AI revenue, international business growth
source_used: Reuters (text read on The Hindu BusinessLine)
key_facts: Shares of Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) rose 5.2% to 2,183.90 rupees on Friday 9 Oct 2026.
TCS's annualised AI-related revenue jumped nearly 20% quarter on quarter to $3.1 billion in July to September, from $2.6 billion.
Growth in its international business also cheered investors.
Morningstar analysts like TCS's leadership in AI implementation but cut their fair value estimate to 2,360 rupees from 2,400 rupees, citing a slowdown among consumer clients.
Emkay said investments in AI partnerships, talent and new businesses should weigh on near-term margins.
The US government has suspended TCS and other technology firms from its Permanent Labor Certification programme; TCS said it expects no material impact on its workforce strategy or clients.
India's Nifty IT index rose as much as 3.1% on the day.
quote_evidence: Shares of information technology firm Tata Consultancy Services rose on Friday on accelerating AI-related revenue and growth in its international business.
TCS said it does not expect the suspension to have any material impact on its workforce strategy or client engagements.
why_it_matters_hint: AI-related sales at one of India's biggest IT services firms are growing fast enough to lift its share price.
notes: Reuters page blocked (401); Reuters text read on The Hindu BusinessLine, which credits Reuters. Reuters headlined a separate piece on 8 Oct about TCS posting its weakest September-quarter growth in three years (headline seen only, not read).
